title: A Language for the Silence
author: August Amberdale
blurb: Ansel Marchetti, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
